about: src/lib/purchase_vectors.json is a byte-for-byte copy of madar-shared's file at this tag (madar-inventory purchase: quantity_milli, delivery_cost, estimate_line_total, unit_cost_from_total; the backend's purchasing handlers). src/features/inventory/lib.test.ts runs the dashboard's wrappers (the wasm) against it. A change is made there, released with a tag, and copied here with the tag and hash below updated; scripts/check-shared-vectors.sh (CI) and shared_vectors.test.ts check it.
